verdict.rationale: Bugbot is a hosted PR-review service, so an official MCP server for connecting agents is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence covers PR comments, manual triggers, Fix in Cursor/Web links, rules files, and repo integrations, but never mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint. The llms.txt and docs-md probes show machine-readable docs, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
